definitions.explanation: A room in Japanese schools where students can rest when sick or receive first aid.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}くて→悪い：00908_warui⟧{保健室|ほけんしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I felt sick so I went to the nurse's office.

examples.japanese: {保健室|ほけんしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}んでいる→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I'm resting in the nurse's office.

examples.japanese: {保健室|ほけんしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I consulted with the school nurse.
examples.notes: 保健室の先生 = school nurse

notes:
{保健室|ほけんしつ} is staffed by a {保健室|ほけんしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧ or ⟦{養護教諭|ようごきょうゆ}→養護教諭：28830_yougokyouyu⟧ (school nurse/health teacher). Students can rest there when feeling unwell.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {保健室|ほけんしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to the nurse's office
- {保健室|ほけんしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧: to rest in the nurse's office

CULTURAL NOTE:
The school nurse often provides emotional support as well as physical first aid.
